before_upload.name: 校验并查看当前 Compose 镜像版本
commands: sed -n '/^  ${SERVICE_NAME}:/,/^  [^[:space:]]/p' ${COMPOSE_FILE} | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*image:[[:space:]]*//p' | head -n 1 | sed 's/^"//;s/"$//;s/^/当前镜像: /'
sed -n '/^  ${SERVICE_NAME}:/,/^  [^[:space:]]/p' ${COMPOSE_FILE} | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*image:[[:space:]]*//p' | head -n 1 | sed 's/^"//;s/"$//' | rev | cut -d: -f1 | rev | sed 's/^/当前版本: /'

after_upload.name: 更新 Compose service 镜像版本
commands: sed -n '/^  ${SERVICE_NAME}:/,/^  [^[:space:]]/p' ${COMPOSE_FILE} | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*image:[[:space:]]*//p' | head -n 1 | sed 's/^"//;s/"$//' | rev | cut -d: -f1 | rev | sed 's/^/新版本: /'
